shellCommands.command: ls -la && git log --stat | head -30 && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; head -c 600 package-lock.json; node --version; npm --version

export BOOKS_FILE=/tmp/smoke/books.json PORT=3999; rm -rf /tmp/smoke
node server.js & PID=$!; sleep 0.5
LOC=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{redirect_url}' -d 'title=The Hobbit&author=J.R.R. Tolkien&notes=Re-read for the dragon.' localhost:3999/books); echo "created: $LOC"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'finish -> %{http_code}\n' -X POST "$LOC/finish"
kill $PID; wait $PID 2>/dev/null
node server.js & PID=$!; sleep 0.5
curl -s "$LOC" | grep -E '<h1>|author|Finished|notes"'
curl -s localhost:3999/ | grep -A3 '<h2>Finished'
kill $PID; cat /tmp/smoke/books.json; rm -rf /tmp/smoke
